subject: Coord: SOC2 / DPA walkthrough — window swap and pen-test kickoff

Cc: security@bridgetech.com

Subject: SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough and pen-test kickoff availability

Hi Kimberly —

We're preparing for our SOC 2 intake and would like to schedule a joint walkthrough to review evidence locations, DPA items, and kick off a light pen-test. Our vendor is available the week of Dec 14 and proposed two windows that work for their team:

- Tue, Dec 15 — 09:00–10:00 ET
- Wed, Dec 16 — 15:00–16:00 ET

Can you confirm which (if either) works for Redwood? Also:
- We'll need to confirm whether pen-test access will be limited to staging/non-prod or if we should plan for a narrow production scope.
- Please share any preferred evidence folders (Drive link) and a contact for the pen-test technical lead.

Attaching our SOC2 checklist to help prioritize artifacts (SOC2-Checklist.xlsx).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Elliot Strauss
Director, IT & Security
BridgeTech
elliot.strauss@bridgetech.com

Thanks for the note and the checklist. Quick update from our side: I have a company town hall that overlaps with Tue 9–10 ET, so I can't make that slot. We can do either of the following options:

- Tue, Dec 15 — 11:00–12:00 ET (I can move other items)
- Wed, Dec 16 — 15:00–16:00 ET (Vivek will lead the pen-test scope discussion)

Vivek, copying you to confirm availability and whether Redwood's pen-test playbook requires any extra prep on BridgeTech's side. Marissa, adding you for intake of evidence and for the Drive share.

For now I've attached our internal pen-test FAQ and an evidence checklist so we can align expectations (Redwood-pen-test-faq.pdf). If Dec 16 works, we'll plan to:

- 15:00–15:10 — Introductions & meeting goals
- 15:10–15:40 — Evidence & DPA items review (Marissa to confirm locations)
- 15:40–16:00 — Pen-test scope & next steps (Vivek)

If you prefer the earlier slot on Tue we'll try to accommodate but would prefer to keep the session contiguous (no split).

Best,

Kimberly / Elliot —

I can take the pen-test portion on Wed, Dec 16 at 15:00 ET — that works for me. A couple of quick asks so we can scope properly:

- Please confirm the pen-test contact for BridgeTech (name + email) so we can coordinate credentialing and the blast radius.
- Would you prefer the test be limited to staging only? If you want a narrow production test we need a short doc with the approved endpoints and escalation contacts.
- We usually run a lightweight pre-check (15–20 min) with the vendor the day before; happy to schedule that if the vendor is available.

If Wed 16 is confirmed I'll shoot a calendar invite from Redwood with the Zoom link and include a short agenda.
